history.content: My phone is still really slow compared to my husband's, even though I can get online. Pages just take forever to load and it never switches to the faster network like his does.

I can help you troubleshoot your slow mobile data issue. To get started, I’ll need to identify your account and line so I can check your plan and settings. Could you please provide your phone number, or your full name and date of birth? This will help me assist you more effectively.
My name is Sofia Martinez and my phone number is +1-617-555-0148.

Thank you for the information. To help resolve your slow data issue, I’ll need to check a few things on your device, such as your current network connection and settings. 

Could you please let me know if you are able to run some quick checks on your phone? If so, I’ll guide you through the steps to diagnose and improve your data speed.
Yes, I can run checks on my phone. Just let me know what you need me to do.

Great! Let’s start by checking your phone’s current network status and preferred network mode. This will help us see if your phone is connecting to the fastest available network (like 4G or 5G).

Please do the following two checks on your phone:
1. Check your network status (including signal strength and network type).
2. Check your network mode preference (to see if your phone is set to prefer 4G/5G).

Let me know the results you see for both checks, and I’ll guide you from there.
I checked my network status and it shows signal strength is excellent, network type is 4G, and mobile data is enabled. Data roaming is off.

Thank you for the details. Now, please check your network mode preference and let me know what it says (for example, if it’s set to 4G only, 5G preferred, 3G, etc.). This will help determine if your phone is set to connect to the fastest available network.
My network mode preference is set to 4G only.

Thank you for checking. Since your phone is set to “4G only,” it will not connect to 5G networks, which could explain why your data is slower than your husband’s if he is using 5G.

Would you like to switch your network mode preference to “4G/5G preferred” so your phone can use the fastest available network? If yes, I’ll guide you through the steps to make this change.
Yes, I'd like to switch to 4G/5G preferred. Please guide me through the steps.

Please follow these steps to change your network mode preference to “4G/5G preferred”:

1. Open your phone’s network settings.
2. Look for the option labeled “Network Mode” or “Preferred Network Type.”
3. Select “4G/5G preferred” from the list of options.

Once you’ve made this change, please let me know. Afterward, I recommend restarting your phone to ensure the new settings take effect and to help your device connect to the fastest available network. Let me know when you’ve completed these steps or if you need any help along the way!
I've changed the network mode to 4G/5G preferred as you instructed. Would you like me to restart my phone now?

Yes, please restart your phone now. This will help your device apply the new network settings and connect to the fastest available network.

After your phone restarts, try browsing the internet or loading a few pages to see if your data speed has improved. Let me know how it goes or if you notice any difference!
My phone rebooted successfully, but the internet is still slow and pages are still loading very slowly. What should I try next?

Thank you for letting me know. Since switching to 4G/5G preferred and rebooting didn’t resolve the slow data issue, let’s try a few more troubleshooting steps:

1. Please run a speed test on your phone and let me know the download speed result (e.g., very poor, poor, fair, good, excellent).
2. Check if you have a VPN enabled on your phone, as VPNs can sometimes slow down your connection. If it’s on, let me know.
3. Let me know if Data Saver mode is enabled on your phone.

Once you provide these details, I’ll guide you on the next steps to improve your data speed.
I ran the speed test and it showed very poor download speed and poor connection quality. It's still on 4G, not 5G. What should I do next?

Thank you for the update. Since your speed test shows a very poor download speed and your phone is still on 4G despite being set to 4G/5G preferred, let’s check for other possible causes:

1. Is a VPN currently enabled on your phone?
2. Is Data Saver mode enabled?
3. Are you indoors or in an area where 5G coverage might be weak? (Sometimes, even with excellent 4G signal, 5G may not be available everywhere.)

Please check and let me know the status of VPN and Data Saver mode. If either is enabled, I’ll guide you to turn them off. If both are off, I’ll suggest the next steps.
VPN is not enabled and Data Saver mode is off. I'm currently at home in Boston, but I've had this problem everywhere I go.

Thank you for confirming those details. Since VPN and Data Saver mode are both off, and you experience slow speeds everywhere (not just at home), let’s check one more important setting: your APN (Access Point Name) settings. Incorrect APN settings can cause slow data speeds.

Please check your APN settings and let me know:
- The APN name shown
- If there is an MMSC URL listed

Once you provide this information, I’ll advise you on the next steps.
My APN name is 'fast.telecom.net', the status says it's correct, and there is an MMSC URL listed: http://mms.telecom.net/mms/wapenc.

Your plan is the Advantage 50GB, and you have used about 12.4GB out of your 50GB monthly data limit, so you have not reached your data cap. All your device and account settings appear correct, and there are no restrictions or overages affecting your speed.

Since you are still experiencing slow speeds everywhere, even with excellent signal and correct settings, this may be due to local network congestion or a technical issue with your line’s provisioning that cannot be resolved through standard troubleshooting.

Would you like me to transfer you to a human agent for further investigation and advanced support?
